protocol_correction: At most one tool-free, schema-constrained complete-answer correction per eligible discovery, assessor or focused-discussion session, inside its original grant, shared accounting and remaining timeout. Only deterministic machine-describable answer defects qualify. Scrutare never repairs/drops/clamps findings or candidate IDs. Unchanged validation decides the model replacement. Still-invalid or unanswered corrections fail the session and cell, count against36/36 and are not excluded or eligible for a transient rerun. Native/provider/input/cap/budget failures retain their handling. Both flags do not yield two turns: protocol correction takes precedence.
